prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='rf', seasonality_champion='DWT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: The STL decomposition reveals an upward trend in both validation folds with significant seasonal amplitude (57-95). While multiple models achieve perfect trend correlation (1.0), rf is selected as trend champion due to strong overall performance. DWT_rf dominates seasonality capture with 0.4938 correlation, far exceeding others. The extreme RMSE spread ratio (11.4) and high model disagreement indicate substantial performance heterogeneity, making STL-hierarchical stacking ideal to exploit decomposition-aware combination while handling the variance. Early/late horizon specialists differ (FT_catboost vs rf), further supporting per-horizon or decomposition-based methods over simple averaging.
